title: Momoi Airi — Special Collab Stream!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Before the show stream
The Lumina Forum - Rehearsal Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, that looked good.
I thought we were pretty in sync there.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree since we also projected our voices very well.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's basically it for this dress rehearsal...
Is there anything that you'd like to go over again?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I don't think so.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, all that's left is the actual show.
Let's do our best to make sure everybody has fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Hey, it's MMJ.>
<You're in your stage outfits today.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you guys, look at the monitor!
We're on right now!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Perfect timing. That means we can do some advertising.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
We're gonna put on a mini-concert in a moment.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You can see it on the official MORE MORE JUMP! channel, so come tune in if you're free!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<A mini-concert?! I'm so watching!>
<I can't believe I get to see an MMJ show.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
Let's have a wonderfully fun time together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll be doing a solo medley for this one, so we hope you'll look forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Oh, a solo medley!>
<I have some time, so I might watch.>
<I've been looking forward to this for so long!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Getting to promote it on this stream is huge. I hope we can get a bunch more viewers to tune in...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I've never seen Momoi do a show before.>
<She is known for being on variety shows.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Yeah, a lot of people still seem to feel that way.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'll have you guys eating out of my hand after you see me sing and dance! I'm gonna show you all that Airi Momoi is about more than just variety shows♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, see you guys in a bit!
One hour later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, it's finally begun!
The MORE MORE JUMP! mini-concert!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Are you all ready to have lots of fun?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Yeeeaahh!!>
<I've got my glow sticks ready!>
<I'm so excited!!!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. You guys sound ready.
Then, let's jump right in with our solo medley.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Leading off for us is Haruka!
You ready?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm ready!
I promise to sing with everything I have and reach you all through your screens.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Haruka's so cool!>
<She's soloing this song?>
<Raise the roof, you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Minori's doing even better than she did during our rehearsal. And everyone's posting a ton of comments... Way to go!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Haruka and Shizuku are also doing a good job of putting their own strengths on display, and they're really captivating everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (That means I also gotta give them a huge burst of energy!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks for listening, you guys!
Last but not least in our solo medley is...Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Let's keep turning the heat up!
I'm gonna give it everything I've got, so you guys gotta shout for me at the top of your lungs!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<It's finally Airi's turn!!!>
<Hey! Hey! Hey! Hey!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi seems so motivated.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. Not only does her performance feel powerful, she's dancing with so much precision. You can tell that she really wants everybody to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I was right to come up with a solo version of this dance. Because I'm by myself, I can make use of the whole stage...)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You're amazing, Airi!>
<She's gotten even better?!>
<Way to go, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Looks like they're all having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I'm just getting started!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I need to reach them through their screens. I need to move the hearts of everyone watching, more and more!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, Airi, this is awesome...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My heart's really racing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huff... Huff...
Thanks for enjoying our solo medley, you guys!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That was so awesome!!>
<You were all really cute!>
<That was the best medley ever!!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much!
We're glad that all our practicing paid off.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<That Airi girl at the end was great!>
<I didn't know Momoi could do that.>
<This really changes my perceptions about her.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I was able to get through to them.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Moving forward, I'm gonna do everything I can to show them all the different aspects of me...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And get more and more people to learn about Airi Momoi from MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Anyway, this show's just getting started!
Next, the four of us are gonna take the stage together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's keep this energy up until the very end!
